summary: All backend (14/14) and frontend (7/7) tests passed for /api/beta/tester-activity, /me, and /qualified-testers plus /beta page checklist UI wiring. Idempotency, email/date validation, admin auth, and aggregation all verified.
critical_code_review_comments: beta.py grew to ~345 lines mixing bug reports, suggestions, tester activity, counts, and CSV export — consider splitting into beta/activity.py and beta/admin.py when it grows further.
No MongoDB unique index on (email, date, item_id) — idempotency relies on the app-layer upsert; a compound unique index would harden against concurrent writes.

GET /api/beta/tester-activity/me is unauthenticated and takes an email in the querystring — any actor can enumerate any tester's activity. Fine for the beta phase but should require the tester email cookie or a signed token later.
min_full_days validator caps at 90; the spec test case ?min_full_days=999 will return 422 instead of qualified_count:0 (test adapted to use 90, which correctly returned 0).
seed_data_creation: Per-test unique emails (activity_test_<ts>@example.com and ui_test_<ts>@example.com) to avoid state bleed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_beta_tester_activity.py covers all activity endpoints. Note ?min_full_days upper bound is 90 (not 999) — 999 returns 422.
